messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The indexer relies on the product catalog for product documents, so if the product catalog is down the indexer is down. [valid 2025-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-30]
- The product catalog can be released on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays; the previous Mon-Thu 09:00-17:00 UTC window no longer applies. [constraint; valid 2025-09-03 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-09-03]
    earlier: The product catalog can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception. [constraint; valid 2025-03-17 to 2025-09-03; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-03-17]
- The product catalog calls the image resizer for thumbnails. [valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-14]
- As of 2025-11-11, the billing API has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 for the peak season. [constraint; valid 2025-11-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-11-11]
- The image resizer is a hard dependency of the product catalog. [valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-14]
- As of 2026-03-11, the ledger service has a deploy freeze from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 for the fiscal year close. [constraint; valid 2026-03-11 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-11]
- Dashboards and alerts for the product catalog are being repointed as of the 2025-12-19 handover. [valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
- As of 2025-12-19, the Atlas team is taking over the product catalog from the Cinder team. [decision; valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
- The product catalog is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-12-19, having moved from Cinder. [decision; valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
    earlier: Cinder owns the product catalog. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-19; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- Lena is the release captain for Q1 2026. [valid 2025-05-22 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-22]
- As of 2026-02-03, the Atlas team has a no-deploy Friday. [decision; valid 2026-02-03 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-02-03]
- Per the 2026-04-14 Dune team standup, Farah is release captain for Q3 2025. [valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14-3]
- The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so if the bus is down the notifier is down. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-11]
- The product catalog keeps image metadata in a separate table because the joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time. [valid 2025-04-17 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-17]
- The webhook dispatcher relies on the bus for outbound events, so if the bus is down the webhook dispatcher is down. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-11-2]
- On 2026-06-04 the Boreal team noticed that the product catalog's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-06-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-06-04]
- The product catalog still relies on the image resizer. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- The ledger service relies on the auth gateway for service tokens, so if the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down. [valid 2025-03-04 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-04]
- As of 2025-04-24, the Cinder team reported that the feature-flags service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-04-24 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-24-2]
- As of 2026-05-29, Oskar is the primary on-call for the Ember team, taking over from Diego. [valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-15, Diego is the primary on-call for the Ember team. [valid 2026-01-15 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-15]

Question: What is the current deploy window for the catalog?

message.reasoning:
The question asks about the current deploy window for the product catalog. Memory says:

"The product catalog can be released on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays; the previous Mon-Thu 09:00-17:00 UTC window no longer applies. [constraint; valid 2025-09-03 to now]"

So the answer: weekdays 08:00–10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.
